rationale.edition: The diff spans both editions. Enterprise-owned paths include o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/llm_evaluations/** (results, runner, score_configs, providers, scorers) and the web/src/enterprise/** online-evals / AIObservability layer (TraceScoreChips, ProviderFormPage, ExperimentDetailPage). OSS paths include src/api/management/** (models/experiments.rs, providers/mod.rs, score_configs), src/core/src/providers.rs, and web/src/components|services|utils|plugins/**. The enterprise Rust is #[cfg(feature = "enterprise")]-gated and the new score chips render inside the OSS trace details sidebar, so this is a linked OSS+ENT change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. Neither feature_hint.txt nor trigger_comment.txt contains a skip/opt-out marker, and the change is clearly user-facing (new score chips on the trace details sidebar, resolved-endpoint column in LLM provider settings, task/score outcome cards on the experiment detail page). needs_e2e is true.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted because TraceDetailsSidebar.vue now renders the new TraceScoreChips component for LLM spans. A user can exercise real UI behavior: chips appear per evaluator score, overflow folds behind a '+N more' dropdown, and an empty state renders when no scores exist. That is a new, verifiable interaction flow.
rationale.area: Traces. The new chips render in web/src/plugins/traces/TraceDetailsSidebar.vue, and the sibling E2E specs live in tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Traces/ (traceDetails.spec.js, tracesSearch.spec.js, etc.).
rationale.group: Traces shard. The closest existing ci_matrix group is testfolder 'Traces' (actual_folder 'Traces', run_files includes traceDetails.spec.js), which is where a span/trace-detail spec belongs.
rationale.existing_tests: One Playwright E2E spec is touched in the diff — tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Pipelines/pipelines-form-validation.spec.js — but it is a maintenance fix (gracefully skipping the enterprise-only destination form) and is unrelated to trace-score-chips, so it provides no coverage of the new feature. The many *.spec.ts files in the diff are Vitest unit tests and do not count as E2E coverage.
